new_string.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete old_string.

old_string.description: Exact file text to find. Must match exactly one place.

edits.description: Replacements applied serially; later items on the same path see earlier successful writes.

items.description: One item in a serial apply_edits batch. Item failures stay item-level.

results.description: Same length and order as edits.

new_string.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete old_string.

old_string.description: Exact file text to find. Must match exactly one place.

output_schema.description: Successful single-edit payload. Failures use ToolFailure.

pattern.description: Glob relative to path, or to the workspace root when path is omitted.

paths.description: Matching paths sorted by depth, then parent directory, then name.

pattern.description: Regular expression over file contents, unless literal is true.

before.description: Lines of context before each hit. 0–10.

after.description: Lines of context after each hit. 0–10.

glob.description: One glob or comma-separated globs. A leading ! excludes. Relative to path.

literal.description: Search for pattern as plain text.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the workspace.

text.description: Matching line text, capped at 500 characters. With `before`/`after` this is a whole block in ripgrep notation, newline-separated: `12- before`, `13: match`, `14+ after` (real file line numbers).

items.description: One match. Context, when requested, is folded into `text` as one block.

truncated.description: True when a limit or the 8K-token data guard removed results or context.

read.doc: Read lines from one file or archived session transcript.

path.description: Prefer a workspace-relative path. Past session transcripts are readable at .litecode/sessions/<session_id>.md.

lines.description: Line contents for this page, in file order.

start_line.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

write.doc: Replace a file's contents; optional hash and create-only guards.

content.description: Content to write to the file.

create_only.description: If true, refuse to overwrite an existing file.

expected_hash.description: sha256 of the current file bytes. Omit to skip the check. A mismatch is ToolFailure reason stale.

created.description: True when the file did not exist before.

hash.description: sha256 hex of the file bytes.

path.description: Workspace-relative path inside the workspace; requested path outside it.

abs.description: Absolute path when the file is outside the workspace.

message.description: Post-write warnings such as LSP errors or path-risk notes.

code_search.doc: Semantic search over the workspace code index.

include_pattern.description: Optional glob filter for workspace paths.

min_score.description: Minimum raw dense cosine similarity for dense-only hits. 0–1. Lexical hits are not subject to this floor; 0 disables it.

start_line.description: First line in the returned snippet.

end_line.description: Last line in the returned snippet.

symbol.description: Optional AST symbol enclosing the anchor.

via.description: Which retrieval leg(s) admitted this chunk.

dense_similarity.description: Raw dense cosine similarity; 0.0 means the hit is lexical-only.

text.description: The anchor line itself, cheap enough for a table cell.

snippet.description: Source excerpt, at most 24 lines; overlong lines are capped.

hits.description: Empty if the search completed but found no matching chunks.

query.description: What to find in past session transcripts. Literal words or a phrase.

session_id.description: Optional session scope: full id, unique prefix, or the handle from a result.

session.description: Shortest unique session handle, also accepted by `session_id`.

age.description: Relative age of the session's last update.

line.description: 1-based rendered transcript line of the hit.

via.description: Evidence that found this row, in rank order: `exact`, `prox`, `lex`, `sem`, `fuzzy`, joined by `+`.

hits.description: Flat rank order; not grouped by session.

total.description: Total matching rows before `limit` is applied.

truncated.description: True when `total` exceeds the returned rows.

kill.doc: Terminate a command job in this session.

id.description: Command.id from a tools.process.run or tools.process.wait result whose exit_code is null.

anyOf.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

exit_code.description: Process exit code when finished; null when still running or unavailable.

id.description: While exit_code is null, use with tools.process.wait / tools.process.kill in this session.

output.description: Stdout plus truncation notes, spill path, or status line. Always present, may be empty.

stderr.description: Stderr plus truncation notes. Empty when nothing was written.

killed.description: True when wait observes a kill.

message.description: Warning about the command itself or a still-alive signal.

command.description: Shell command to run once in the workspace root. Chain with && for cd or env changes.

anyOf.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

id.description: While exit_code is null, use with tools.process.wait / tools.process.kill in this session.

message.description: Warning about the command itself or a still-alive signal.

id.description: Command.id from a tools.process.run result whose exit_code is null.

sec.description: Seconds to block waiting for exit. 1–300.

anyOf.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

exit_code.description: Process exit code when finished; null when still running or unavailable.

id.description: While exit_code is null, use with tools.process.wait / tools.process.kill in this session.

killed.description: True when wait observes a kill.

message.description: Warning about the command itself or a still-alive signal.

url.description: URL to fetch. Only http(s) URLs are accepted.

status.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

snippet.description: Query-relevant excerpt from the page, as returned by the provider.

results.description: At most top_k hits, best first.

ref.description: Element reference from the latest browser_read.
